module_summary: 10G Ethernet MAC with FIFOs: dual-clock AXI-stream FIFOs bridge logic_clk to the XGMII MAC's tx/rx clocks, with toggle synchronizers bringing MAC error pulses into the logic domain.

anchors.name: tx_axis_tdata
anchors.why: Transmit AXI-stream payload written into the TX async FIFO.

anchors.name: tx_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: Valid of transmit AXI-stream input into TX FIFO.

anchors.name: tx_axis_tready
anchors.why: TX FIFO backpressure ready to the transmit AXI source.

anchors.name: rx_axis_tdata
anchors.why: Received frame payload read out of the RX async FIFO.

anchors.name: rx_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: Valid of receive AXI-stream output from RX FIFO.

anchors.name: rx_axis_tready
anchors.why: Downstream ready popping the RX FIFO output.

anchors.name: xgmii_rxd
anchors.why: XGMII receive data into the MAC RX engine.

anchors.name: xgmii_txd
anchors.why: XGMII transmit data produced by the MAC TX engine.

anchors.name: tx_fifo_axis_tdata
anchors.why: TX FIFO output stream feeding the MAC transmit input.

anchors.name: tx_fifo_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: Valid between TX FIFO and MAC transmit engine.

anchors.name: rx_fifo_axis_tdata
anchors.why: MAC receive stream written into the RX FIFO.

anchors.name: rx_fifo_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: Valid between MAC receive engine and RX FIFO.

anchors.name: tx_sync_reg_1
anchors.why: Toggle register in tx_clk domain capturing underflow pulses for CDC to logic_clk.

anchors.name: rx_sync_reg_1
anchors.why: Toggle register in rx_clk domain capturing bad frame/FCS pulses for CDC.

anchors.name: tx_error_underflow
anchors.why: Synchronized TX underflow pulse from XOR of sync stages 3 and 4.

anchors.name: rx_error_bad_frame
anchors.why: Synchronized RX bad-frame pulse from XOR of sync stages.

anchors.name: rx_error_bad_fcs
anchors.why: Synchronized RX bad-FCS pulse from XOR of sync stages.

anchors.name: tx_fifo_overflow
anchors.why: TX FIFO overflow status from write side.

anchors.name: rx_fifo_overflow
anchors.why: RX FIFO overflow status from read side.

anchors.name: cfg_ifg
anchors.why: Inter-frame gap configuration passed to the MAC.

anchors.name: cfg_tx_enable
anchors.why: Enables MAC transmit path.

anchors.name: cfg_rx_enable
anchors.why: Enables MAC receive path.

anchors.name: m_axis_tx_ptp_ts_96
anchors.why: TX PTP timestamp output; tied to zero since PTP_TS_ENABLE=0.

groups.name: tx_fifo_path
groups.description: Async TX FIFO moving frames from logic_clk to tx_clk toward the MAC.

groups.name: rx_fifo_path
groups.description: Async RX FIFO moving received frames from rx_clk to logic_clk.

groups.name: mac_core
groups.description: 10G MAC converting between AXI-stream and XGMII, configured by cfg inputs.

groups.name: status_sync
groups.description: Toggle synchronizers bringing MAC error pulses into logic_clk domain.

groups.name: ptp_ts_out
groups.description: Disabled PTP timestamp path; outputs tied to zero.
